description: A stereo filter whose frequency response morphs continuously from a steep low pass through a gentler one and a band pass to a high pass.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the cutoff. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune on the cutoff instead.
How much the Q jack moves the resonance.
Morphs the response from a twenty-four decibel low pass through a twelve decibel low pass and a band pass to a high pass.
How much the MORPH jack moves that response.
Sets how the two sides are used: up filters left and right separately, middle drives the two filters' modulation in opposite directions, down filters IN 1 alone and places it across the stereo pair.

inputs.text: Moves the response shape, by as much as the MOD knob beside MORPH allows.
Moves the resonance, by as much as the MOD knob beside Q allows.
Sets the cutoff at one volt per octave.
Moves the cutoff, at one volt per octave with the MOD knob beside FQ fully up.
Audio into the filter, left side.
Audio into the filter, right side.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
